items.claim: A CSF argType `if` condition ignores frame-local args, so a control stays shown (or hidden) by a value the story no longer renders with
A render with a default or rest parameter loses its component's prop-derived controls
A URL number knob outside its leaf's range is written into the config unclamped
runStory themes the story host from the toolbar globals and ignores the story's own `globals`
sameKnob treats Infinity, -Infinity, NaN and null as the same value
withUnsent restores a list's left-behind fields by index, so deleting an entry moves another entry's callbacks onto it
The URL drops every `$`-prefixed config key, but forge only owns `$globals` and the playhead key
[r47-1] select/radio with non-string options (carried, A+B)
items.note: (no longer applies). `optionChoice` in `packages/forge/src/csf/argsToSchema.ts` now reads number, boolean, bigint, null and undefined options through `String()`. Options with no string form, or ones that read alike, log a `console.warn` and fall back to a field typed from the arg's value. `argsToSchema.test.ts:101-103` covers both cases.

items.claim: [r47-6] function-valued annotations in the `ready` message (carried, B)
items.note: (no longer applies). `describeShape` now passes annotations through `dataOf`, which drops functions. The frame runs an action's `run` (`runsInFrame`, commit 9452ec197d). Covered by `schema.test.ts:83-89`.

items.claim: [r47-8] schema description drops `enableIf`, `auto`, `resettable`, `motif` and `dialog` (carried, B)
items.note: question (whether to take on the rest now). Commit f3f4f31a27 fixed `enableIf` (the frame answers it, sent as `gated`) and `resettable`. The other three are filed as a P3 in `docs/TODO.md` ("An isolated story's `.auto()` leaf, `.dialog()` row and group `.motif()` do not reach the workshop's panel"):

items.claim: [r47-9] cleared clearable number writes no URL param (carried, B)
items.note: (no longer applies). `knobsToParams` now writes an empty param for a cleared knob (`isClearedKnob`), and `decodeKnob` reads `''` on a clearable number or enum back as cleared. Covered by `url.test.ts:143`.

items.claim: [r47-11] an arg holding a Proxy gets a control (carried, B)
items.note: (no longer applies). `isPortSafe` now also requires `structuredClone` to succeed, and `splittable` won't split a Proxy whose members each cross on their own. Covered in `portSafe.test.ts` and `argsToSchema.test.ts`.

items.claim: A `select`/`radio` control whose `options` are not all strings disappears, and with no control type it becomes a free field
A Storybook number control with only `min` (or only `max`) loses its bound, though labkit can hold one
A URL param for an object or union knob is accepted with any fields and any tag
`weaselforge build --out` overrides a config's own `build.emptyOutDir: true`
`updateArgs({ key: undefined })` puts the story's own arg back instead of clearing it
`describeSchema` copies function-valued annotations into the `ready` message, which a port cannot clone
A CSF story's `globals` are read for the viewport only; the story renders under the toolbar's globals regardless
The schema description drops `enableIf`, `auto`, `resettable`, `motif` and `dialog`, so the workshop panel ignores them
A cleared clearable number writes no URL param, so the link reopens it at its default
An argType `if` on an arg that has no control reads it as undefined, so the conditioned control hides for good
An arg holding a Proxy gets a control, and its default then fails the `ready` post
`runStory`'s doc says it renders with no globals, but it takes and applies `globals`
